verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no-code invoice creation from the Dashboard, a reusable product/price catalog for line items, and credit notes for adjusting finalized invoices. None of it documents tiered, volume, graduated, or per-unit pricing models, hybrid subscription-plus-usage billing, prepaid credits, commitments, or overage. Credit notes are refund and adjustment tools, an adjacent feature rather than credit-based pricing, and a price catalog is not a pricing-model engine.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can price with tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription-plus-usage models — including credits, commitments, and overage — without custom code
